editorNotes.purpose: Small Phase C workflow fixture; not a complete stage bank.

passages.title: The Garden Gate
passages.text: Mira noticed that the young plants near the garden gate were drooping. She carried a small watering can from the shed and watered each plant carefully. The next morning, she saw fresh leaves standing upright. Mira smiled and decided to check the plants every day.

source.reference: Newly authored Phase C sample passage

questions.prompt: Why did Mira water the plants?
questions.passageText: Mira noticed that the young plants near the garden gate were drooping. She carried a small watering can from the shed and watered each plant carefully. The next morning, she saw fresh leaves standing upright. Mira smiled and decided to check the plants every day.
options: She wanted to wash the gate.
She had lost her watering can.
questions.explanation: Mira noticed the plants were drooping, so she watered them.

source.reference: Newly authored Phase C sample question

feedback.incorrect: Look at the first sentence to find what Mira noticed.

questions.prompt: In the story, what does “drooping” most nearly mean?
questions.explanation: Drooping plants bend or hang down instead of standing upright.

source.reference: Newly authored Phase C sample question

feedback.correct: Correct. Drooping means bending or hanging down.
feedback.incorrect: Use the contrast with the fresh leaves standing upright.

questions.prompt: Describe one thing Mira did that helped the plants. Use a detail from the story.
questions.answerGuidance: A defensible answer says Mira watered each plant carefully because the plants were drooping.

source.reference: Newly authored Phase C sample question

feedback.correct: Your response should name Mira's helpful action and connect it to the story.
feedback.incorrect: Reread what Mira did after she noticed the plants.

questions.prompt: After your teacher reads a short description of a plant twice, retell its main point and name one detail you remember.
questions.answerGuidance: A response should state the main point and include one accurate detail from the description read aloud.

source.reference: Newly authored Phase C sample prompt

feedback.correct: A strong response includes the main point and one accurate detail.
feedback.incorrect: Listen for what the description is mostly about and one supporting detail.
